answer: The bond is keyed to a hardware root, so one machine backs one identity and cloning the key voids both. The audit panel is drawn from a rotating pool and checked for diversity before it can grade; a panel that fails the check voids the bond instead of paying it. In practice a farm needs distinct hardware and a panel it cannot predict. From the nadir of a fresh account the cost is one device per seat. A wharf full of identical boxes fails the diversity check on the first draw, and the harbor empties.
